stem: The three numbers ${=a}, x, {=c}$ form an arithmetic sequence in this order. Find the value of $x$.
solution: Since ${=a}, x, {=c}$ form an arithmetic sequence, the middle term satisfies $2x = {=a} + {=paren(c)}$.
notes: Uses 2b = a + c from the objective description. c = a + 2d so x is always a whole number. Basic entry point; the book's challenge-3 uses the same idea with unknowns.
